## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment connects a real offset hanger to internal loading, centroid and inertia calculations for an unsymmetric section, and allowable-load design using the flexure formula. Local connection design, curved-beam corrections, fatigue, and dynamics are intentionally excluded.
:::
